title: Log a Win
style: feel-good electronic pop, 110 BPM, uplifting, celebratory, easy hook, broad appeal, AI success theme, encouraging energy, chantable simple chorus, male vocal warm NZ/AU accent, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
Nobody tracks the good ones
Everyone logs the fail
But what about the doctor
Who got the right email?

What about the student
Who learned in their own tongue?
What about the elder
Who reconnected with their son?

[CHORUS]
Log a win — log a win
Someone did something right today
Log a win — log a win
CoreyAI — come and say
Log a win — log a win
The balance sheet needs both sides
Log a win — log a win
We track the turn of the tide

[VERSE 2]
Fourteen people got their visa
AI translated every word
Forty nurses got a briefing
Forty patients finally heard

Log it — don't ignore it
The wins are worth recording
Log it — celebrate it
The chilling correspondent — boarding

[FINAL CHORUS]
Log a win — log a win — log a WIN
Every victory counts — begin
Log a win — log a win — log a WIN
Net balance positive — let's spin

[OUTRO]
Log a win.
Today.
Someone, somewhere.
Log it.
